summary: Closure review: the two prespecified required revisions from the previous terminal review (1) reporting verifier oracle agreement / FP–FN counts, and (2) explicit listing of the three repair invocation provider_call paths and SHA‑256 checksums, have been added to the manuscript and supported by archived artifacts and checksums. The preregistered analysis, artifacts, and deterministic extraction recipes are present. No new critical issues are introduced. I recommend acceptance for finalisation subject to no further mandatory changes.
optional_revisions: (Optional) Include a one‑line clarifying mapping from provider_call filenames (e.g., suffixes like "-guarded-repair.json" vs "-repair.json") to the exact file names present in execution/provider_calls/ to remove any possible filename‑format ambiguity for reproducibility.

(Optional) Add a very short numeric summary (median, IQR) of blast‑radius diagnostics (observed_touched_field_count, parsed_command_count) for repaired vs non‑repaired episodes; these values are already available in validator_trace fields and would aid operational interpretation.
